The clinical policies within the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] are governed and updated by the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]], which sets standards, development targets, and monitoring practices for various quality indicators. These policies are frequently adjusted based on local clinical audits, patient demographics, and the need to balance competing medical priorities in acute care settings.

A significant policy shift occurred regarding [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]]. The development target and standard were adjusted to 60% after local audits revealed that a substantial number of patients were not actually septic [^src4] [^src5]. Furthermore, the time limit for antibiotic treatment was firmly maintained at 3 hours after patient arrival; this decision was explicitly made as a trade-off to prevent delays in performing a [[ct-skanning|CT-skanning]] [^src4] [^src5].

Other indicators have seen specific target settings and adjustments based on clinical realities. The standard for [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] was set to 80% for the following year [^src2], while the standard for [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] was established at ≥ 90% [^src2], with a consensus that the primary goal is the patient's actual nutritional intake [^src3]. For [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], the target was reduced from 90% to 60% in 2022. This change acknowledged that many patients are comorbid and receive anticoagulant (AK) treatment, which can contraindicate the placement of an [[epidural|epidural]] on the day of surgery [^src6]. Additionally, a new national standard proposing a mortality rate of 12% has been recommended for [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] [^src7].

Regarding the scope of monitoring, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] decided at its 2018 annual meeting to discontinue the monitoring of bleeding ulcers, making 2018 the final year for this specific metric [^src1] [^src8].

## Claims

- Det blev på styregruppens årsmøde i 2018 besluttet at dette var det sidste år med monitorering af blødenede ulcera [^src1] (akut-kirurgi-databasen)
- Standarden for Indikator 6 sættes fra næste år til 80 % [^src1] (indikator-6)
- Standarden for Indikator 7 er ≥ 90 % [^src1] (indikator-7)
- Der er enighed om at det er indtaget ernæring hos patienten, der er målet [^src1] (indikator-7)
- Standarden for Indikator 1 er ændret til 60 %, idet lokale audits har fundet, at mange patienter ikke er septiske [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Tidsgrænsen for Indikator 1 fastholdes på 3 timer efter ankomst, ud fra argumentet om at undgå forsinkelse af CT-skanning [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Udviklingsmålet for Indikator 1 ændres til 60 % idet lokale audits har fundet, at mange patienter ikke er septiske [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Indikator 8 blev i 2022 ændret fra 90 % til 60 % idet mange patienter er komorbide og får AK behandling, hvilket kan kontraindicere epidural anlæggelse i operationsdøgnet [^src1] (indikator-8, epidural)
- Der foreslås at ny national standard er en mortalitet på 12% for Indikator 10 [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Styregruppen besluttede i 2018 at ophøre med monitorering af blødenede ulcera [^src1] (styregruppen)
- Tidsgrænsen for antibiotikabehandling fastholdes på 3 timer efter ankomst ud fra argumentet, at det er en afvejning for at undgå forsinkelse af CT-skanning [^src1] (indikator-1, ct-skanning)
